title: Results Section Audit
subject: Synthetic optimizer results excerpt
summary: The solver logs support a finite descriptive report for 12 instances, including 9 OPTIMAL statuses under a 1% relative MIP-gap tolerance and 3 time-limited feasible incumbents with reported final gaps. They do not support exact global-optimum or 10-second guarantees, or readiness for real-time deployment.
footer: This HTML is a presentation of the canonical text audit and adds no scientific finding, number, correction, or conclusion.

findings.title: Global-optimum and 10-second claim is contradicted
findings.source: The optimizer always returns the global optimum within 10 s.
findings.evidence: The supplied logs report 9 runs with solver status OPTIMAL under a 1% relative MIP-gap tolerance and 3 runs that reached the 60 s time limit with feasible incumbents and nonzero final gaps. No exact-optimality certificate is supplied.
findings.consequence: The sentence makes an unbounded exact-optimality guarantee and a 10-second runtime guarantee that the reported statuses, tolerance, time limit, and final gaps do not establish.
findings.correction: Replace the sentence with the supported finite observation: Across 12 instances, 9 runs ended with solver status OPTIMAL under a 1% relative MIP-gap tolerance, while 3 reached the 60 s time limit with feasible incumbents and final gaps of 4.1%, 5.3%, and 7.8%.

findings.title: Deployment-readiness conclusion lacks evidence
findings.source: The method is therefore ready for real-time deployment.
findings.evidence: No deployment experiment or timing measurements outside the supplied solver logs are provided. The same logs include 60 s time-limit cases with feasible incumbents and final gaps.
findings.consequence: The conclusion extends solver-log observations into an operational deployment claim without evidence for deployment performance or the required real-time timing boundary.
findings.correction: Remove the deployment-readiness sentence. If deployment readiness is intended, supply a deployment experiment and timing measurements outside these solver logs before making that claim.

findings.title: Solver-run reproducibility details are incomplete
findings.source: Across 12 instances, 9 runs ended with solver status OPTIMAL under a 1% relative MIP-gap tolerance, while 3 reached the 60 s time limit with feasible incumbents and final gaps of 4.1%, 5.3%, and 7.8%.
findings.evidence: The excerpt reports the instance count, statuses, tolerance, time limit, and final gaps, but does not supply the solver identity and version, hardware, seeds, or the complete run configuration.
findings.consequence: The reported solver outcomes cannot be fully reconstructed or independently assessed from the excerpt alone.
findings.correction: Retain the reported outcomes, and request the solver identity and version, hardware, seeds, and complete run configuration as external reproducibility details. Do not fill in omitted values.
